    How the LEGO Gift Finder works

    • You're chatting with an AI gifting assistant built by LEGO. It asks a couple of questions, then searches for the strongest match — and explains its reasoning as it goes.
    • Your answers are used only in this session, to search the LEGO range available at Smyths. Nothing is saved, and no account is needed.
    • Prices, stock, delivery and checkout are handled by the retailer. The recommendations and gifting expertise come from LEGO.
    • It's built to be honest: if nothing in this range is a perfect fit for your brief, it will say so rather than oversell.
